[Review turn R1.3]
Reviewer 1, comment R1.3 (verbatim):
Section of the review this comment is under: Round 2 / Minor comments
<<<
In section 3, please say how growth was followed,
and describe the substrate as novel.
>>>

What this comment asks for (put the ids a change answers in rationale.requirement_ids):
- [q1] say how growth was followed
- [q2] describe the substrate as novel
Put in rationale.requirement_ids the id of every request this change handles. If it handles only part of a request, still put its id. Leave it empty only when the change answers none of them.

Paragraphs the author selected (id, index, text):
- id=U9 index=9: Growth was followed at 600 nm.
- id=? index=10: The substrate was a synthetic carbon source.

Author instructions:
- [L1] in vitro 는 하이픈 없이 쓴다
- [L3] 다중비교 문장을 지우지 않는다

Forbidden (an edit containing these is refused before it is applied):
- [L2] novel 을 쓰지 않는다

Rules:
1. Change the manuscript only with office_tracked_edit, one call per change. Every other document-writing tool is disabled in this turn.
2. Make only the changes this comment asks for. Do not delete or add anything the reviewer did not request.
3. Do not write the revision history into the manuscript (no "as suggested by the reviewer", no "in this revised version"). That belongs in the response letter only.
4. Base every change and every rationale on facts in the manuscript or the review. If a rationale is an inference, say so.
5. Write the rationale in Korean: what = what you changed, why = why, addresses = which part of the comment it answers.
6. If office_tracked_edit returns blocked_by, do not retry the same wording. Rephrase without the forbidden expression, or stop and explain.
7. Follow every author instruction below. They are decisions the author already made.

Call office_tracked_edit with comment_ref "R1.3".
